description: Anthropic Claude extended thinking response format
notes: Claude 3.5+ Sonnet and Claude 3 Opus support extended thinking. In the Messages API, thinking content appears as a content block with type='thinking' and a 'thinking' text field. The adapter recognizes both 'thinking' and 'thinking_content' as reasoning fields in structured responses.

examples.name: thinking with tool use

content.thinking: The user wants the weather for Tokyo. I have a get_weather tool available. Let me parse the request: location is Tokyo. They didn't specify a unit, so I'll use celsius as default.

examples.expected_extracted_reasoning: The user wants the weather for Tokyo. I have a get_weather tool available. Let me parse the request: location is Tokyo. They didn't specify a unit, so I'll use celsius as default.

examples.name: thinking with text response

content.thinking: The user just said hello. This is a simple greeting, no tool needed. I'll respond politely.

content.text: Hello! How can I help you today?

examples.expected_extracted_reasoning: The user just said hello. This is a simple greeting, no tool needed. I'll respond politely.
examples.expected_clean_content: Hello! How can I help you today?

examples.name: no thinking (standard mode)

content.text: I'll look up the weather for Tokyo.

examples.expected_clean_content: I'll look up the weather for Tokyo.
